questions.question:
Two places B1 and B2 are 500 km apart from each other. Sonit and Robin start moving from B1 towards B2 at the same time. After reaching B2, they return back to B1. Speed of Sonit is 80 km/hr more than the Robin. If they meet after 6 hours, then which of the following statement(s) is/are correct?

I. Distance covered by Sonit is 600 km.

II. Speed of Robin is 120/3 km/hr.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two places B1 and B2 are 500 km.

The speed of Sonit is 80 km/hr more than the Robin.

They meet after 6 hours.

**Concept Used:**

Distance = Time × Speed

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d41c523098a5ff681453a0359b101c379028ea474f0b76c6513e36d6479183e.png] 

Let the speed of Robin is x km/hr.

And the distance travelled by Robin in 6 hrs y km.

Speed of Sonit = (x + 80) km/hr

The distance travelled by Sonit in 6 hrs = 500 + 500 - y = (1000 - y) km

Distance travelled by Robin in 6hrs = 6x km = y km ...........(i)

Distance travelled by Sonit in 6hrs = 6(x + 80) km

According to the question,

(1000 - y) = 6(x + 80)

Put the value of y from eq (i)

1000 - 6x = 6x + 480

12x = 520

x = 130/3 km/hr

Speed of Robin = 130/3 km/hr

Distance travelled by Robin = (130/3) × 6 = 260 km

Distance travelled by Sonit = 1000 - 6x = 1000 - 6 × 130/3 = 740 km.

Statement I is wrong.

Speed of Robin = 130/3 km/hr

Statement II is wrong.

**∴ Option 3 is the correct answer.**

questions.question: The wheel of a car has 210 cm diameter. How many revolutions per minute must the wheel make so that the speed of the car is kept at 120 km/h?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Diameter if wheel,D = 210 cm = 2.1 m

Speed of car, v = 120 km/hour

**Formula used:**

V = (πDN)/60

V → speed, D → diameter, N → number of revolution

**Calculatioon:**

V = (πDN)/60

⇒ 120 × 5/18 = (π × 2.1 × N)/60

1 km/hour = 5/18 m/s

⇒ N = (120 × 5 × 60)/(18 × 2.1 × π)

⇒ N = 303.03

**∴ Revolution of wheel in a minute is 303.03**

questions.question: X and Y start at the same time to ride from place A to place B, which is 80 km away from A. X travels 4 km per hour slower than Y. Y reaches place B and at once turns back, meeting X, 16 km from place B. Y's speed (in km/h) is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

X and Y start at the same time to ride from place A to place B, which is 80 km away from A

X travels 4 km per hour slower than Y

Y reaches place B and at once turns back meeting X, 16 km from place B.

**Calculation:**

Let the speed of X be p km/hr

The speed of Y = (p + 4) km/hr

Distance travelled by Y = (80 + 16) = 96 km/hr

Distance travelled by X = (80 – 16) = 64 km/hr

According to the question

⇒ 96/(p + 4) = 64/p

⇒ 96p = 64p + 256

⇒ 32p = 256

⇒ p = 8 km

Now,

The speed of Y is (p + 4) = (8 + 4)

⇒ 12 km/hr

**∴ The required speed of Y is 12**

questions.question: Rahul and Mithun travel a distance of 30 km. The sum of their speeds is 70 km/h and the total time taken by both to travel the distance is 2 hours 6 minutes. The difference between their speeds is:

 Rahul and Mithun travel = 30 km 

Sum of their speed = 70 km/h

Distance = speed × time 

**Calculation **

⇒ s² - 50s - 20s + 1000 = 0 

⇒ s(s - 50) - 20(s - 50) = 0 

⇒ (s - 50) (s - 20) = 0

questions.question: If a person travels at a speed of 48 km/h, he will reach his destination on time. He covers two-thirds of his journey in five-sixths of time. At what speed (in km/h) should he travel to cover the remaining distance to reach his destination on time?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Normal speed of the person = 48 km/h

**Concept used:**

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation:**

Let he usually travels for 6x hours

So. his total distance = 48 × 6x

⇒ 288x km

According to the question,

He covered 288x × 2/3 = 192x km in 5x hours

So remaining 288x - 192x = 96x km

He will cover it in x hours

So, speed = 96x/x = 96 km/h

**∴ He should travel 96 km/h to cover the remaining distance to reach his destination on time.**

questions.question: Aman decided to cover a distance of 12 km in 78 minutes. He decided to cover the initial two - thirds of the distance at 10 km/h and the remaining at some different speed. Find the speed for the last one - third of the distance.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Aman decided to cover a distance of 12 km in 78 minutes.

He decided to cover 2/3rd of the distance at 10 km/h .

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time

**Calculation:** 

Time taken to cover 1st 12 × 2/3 = 8 km distance 

⇒ 8 × 60/10 = 48 minutes

Remaining time 78 - 48 = 30

Remaining distance 12 - 8 = 4 km

He has to travel 4 km in 30 minutes 

So the speed will be 4 × 2 = 8 km/h

**∴ The correct option is 2**
